meta_description: Aaron Davitt Painting and Decorating in Newcastle. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration. Call 07562 312732 for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Newcastle & North Shields
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. From fresh walls to full refurbishment, we deliver flawless finishes on time, every time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From interior refresh to exterior protection, we handle every aspect of painting and decoration with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration
services.desc: Fresh paint transforms any room. We prepare surfaces properly, apply premium paints in your chosen colours, and leave spaces spotless. Perfect for kitchens, bedrooms, living areas, and feature walls.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Protection
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with tough exterior paint and coatings. We prep woodwork, masonry, and cladding to ensure lasting protection against Newcastle's climate. Includes gutters, fascias, and soffits.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional hanging of modern and traditional wallpapers, including textured finishes and murals. We remove old paper cleanly, prepare walls, and hang new paper with precision and no visible seams.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, architraves, and window frames demand careful preparation and finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for a smooth, durable result that lasts years.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Painting
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and industrial premises need rapid turnaround and minimal disruption. We schedule work around your business hours and complete projects on budget and on schedule.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Effects
services.desc: Faux finishes, decorative paint techniques, and bespoke colour mixing. Whether you want a Venetian plaster effect or hand-painted detail, we bring your design vision to life.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd be happy to see in my own home.
about_para_1: Aaron Davitt Painting and Decorating has been serving Newcastle and the surrounding North East for 18 years. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local name, completing hundreds of residential and commercial projects without compromising on attention to detail. Every job, from a single bedroom refresh to a full property respray, receives the same level of care and craftsmanship.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up on time, protecting your home during the work, and leaving it cleaner than we found it. We source quality paints and materials, take time to prep surfaces properly, and don't cut corners. Customers return to us because they know what they'll get: honest pricing, professional work, and a genuine interest in exceeding expectations.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Aaron came out to quote us for redecorating three bedrooms and the hall. Turned up on time, gave us a fair price with no pressure. Did the work quickly without faffing about. Walls look perfect. Would definitely have him back.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the whole living room and kitchen done. Aaron sorted the walls, woodwork, and even replaced some damaged skirting. Mate, he's tidy. No mess, no drama, and finished bang on schedule. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Exterior of our house looked tired. Aaron suggested a high-quality masonry paint and did the lot — including gutters and fascias. Three years on and it still looks smart. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Richard P.
